approved_scope.summary: integration test of the EXISTING Step 4 / Step 5 CLIs for a single-PR read-only handoff (extract-vc-metadata -> TEST_VERDICT_MACHINE/v2 -> contract snapshot envelope -> step4-adjudicate -> dispatch_seq -> reviewer_verdict -> step5-terminal-gate), plus a limited real-runtime acceptance run by the main session
not_approved: automatic impl-review-loop start or any automatic Step 1/2/4/5 dispatch
verdict publication or any Reviewer GitHub write
Step 5 Final Gate / LOOP_HANDOFF_RESULT_V1 production wiring
Bot / Broker / controlled pr_* route or permission changes
new wrapper, schema or permanent gate
ensure_contract_snapshot dry-run materialize, auto --post or a hand-made snapshot in the runtime acceptance

not_changed: D1-D15 historical manifests and source pins
existing production scripts, schemas, wrappers and hooks
count_evidence: Measured with pytest --co and a real run; the runner independently verifies per-file counts and JUnit outcome. Fixture level only: real CLIs, a stateful fake gh, no real GitHub, no model call, no SubAgent dispatch.

runtime_acceptance.rule: Accepted only by the main session against the D16 Draft PR, using an existing trusted GO bound to the current default branch tip. If check-only returns human_judgment or base drift the acceptance is BLOCKED. A fixture result is never a runtime PASS; reaching `approved` is not reported as terminal approval success.
commands: (main session) Agent(subagent_type=pr-reviewer) for one PR number and HEAD

rollback: Revert the single D16 PR: it removes this manifest, the D16 test and the CI lane. No production script, document or historical manifest is changed.
ci_binding: The i4-4d16-readonly-handoff job runs this manifest through scripts/ci/run_stage1b1_tests.py and the full tests/stage_i4 directory; no new permissions, runner or secrets.
